name: Round Trip
idea: A single ribbon runs out around the C and, at the mouth, makes a Möbius half-twist that brings it back on its other side: parcel out, cash (ramburs) back, one endless loop.
why: A C that is secretly a closed Möbius loop is simple enough to draw from memory, and the two-tone twist in the mouth gives it one ownable detail no other courier has.
risks: Ring-shaped C marks are common in other sectors, so recognition rests on the twist, which shrinks to a small notch below about 24 px.

colors.name: Deep Teal
colors.use: ribbon body, app icon and brand background

colors.name: Lagoon Aqua
colors.use: the returning side of the ribbon (lower twist)

colors.name: Fold Shadow
colors.use: the turning side of the ribbon (upper twist)

colors.name: Mist
colors.use: upper twist on the reversed and icon versions
